title: SkyrimNet DOM
tagline: LLM actions and prompts for Diary of Mine.
description:
Ships DOMSlave actions, bio/helper prompts, and the Healing Hands trigger used by SkyrimNet_DOM. Requires `SkyrimNet_DOM.esp`.

Plugin menu settings stay in `config/plugins/SkyrimNet_DOM/` (`dom.*` keys). Punishment JSON and runtime actor dumps stay in this mod's `SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet_DOM/`. Item YAML stays at `config/items/`. Decorators and Papyrus execute in this mod's scripts, not in this content folder.
author: goodprovider
